description: Target list for the State of CRA Readiness survey. Replace these illustrative entries with your own curated set of PUBLIC repositories, then run cra-check across them (see README). This file makes no claims about any project; it is only a list of repositories to scan.
selection: Pick a coherent population you can defend - e.g. the most-depended-on OSS in one ecosystem, EU-origin open-source products, or a sector (IoT, fintech SDKs).
Aim for 100-300 repositories so the percentages are meaningful; start smaller to validate the pipeline.
Only scan public repositories. The report aggregates - it does not name or grade any single project.
Record the population definition and the scan date in the report so the methodology is reproducible.
